screening.source: Sony EE Core Instruction Set Manual v6.0 excerpt, printed pages 345-354

results.claim: For finite supported values, C.EQ.S/C.LT.S/C.LE.S update FCR31 condition bit 23 from the comparisons while preserving other bits; signed zero compares equal.
BC1F/BC1T test or invert bit 23, and BC1FL/BC1TL emit the delay slot only on the taken path, matching the manual.
CFC1 of FCR31 sign-extends the 32-bit value into the 64-bit GPR.
CFC1 FCR0 returning zero is a proven Sony EE mismatch because the manual identifies an implementation/revision register.

verification.disposition: No FCR0 numeric-value mismatch claimed; manual does not specify that value, and corpus has no CFC1.

supplemental_user_manual_check.source: Sony EE Core User's Manual v6.0, printed page 158, Table 8-1, https://docs.alexrp.com/mips/ee.pdf

screening.purpose: Screen the Sony EE Core User Manual FCR0 field excerpt as evidence for an audit note about the documented implementation byte and variable revision byte.
screening.exact_screened_text: Sony Computer Entertainment Inc., EE Core User's Manual, Version 6.0, printed page 158, section 8.3.1, Table 8-1 (PDF source https://docs.alexrp.com/mips/ee.pdf): Lines 5089-5092 state that FCR0 is read-only and contains an FPU implementation number and revision number. Table 8-1 (lines 5097-5106) lists bits 31:16 as fixed zero with initial value 0; Imp bits 15:8 as implementation number with initial value 0x2E; and Rev bits 7:0 as revision number, with bits 7:4 major and bits 3:0 minor. It does not give a numeric revision value.

claims.claim: Sony's EE Core User's Manual v6.0 documents FCR0 bits 15:8 as implementation field Imp with initial value 0x2E, bits 31:16 fixed zero, and bits 7:0 as a variable major/minor revision byte without giving a specific revision value.

At pinned PS2Recomp commit c5a9d02573410a2085a4b4b831b0b68ba3515440, the CFC1 translation for fs == 0 emits SET_GPR_U32(ctx, ft, 0x00000000), so it omits the manual's documented nonzero implementation field in bits 15:8.
This FCR0 field mismatch is outside the measured inventory because the inventory contains no CFC1 instruction; the manual does not justify claiming the full correct FCR0 value is 0x2E00.

verification.disposition: Separate supplemental claim verified against the Sony User Manual. The prior instruction-manual-only verification remains unchanged and correctly marked the numeric-value claim unsupported on that evidence.
